summary: Type I inflation measured across 5 candidate grids x 3 sample sizes x 4 selection rules at 20,000 replicates each. Union and first-significant rules coincide exactly and range 8.3-18.7% (1.7-3.7x). Arg-max ranges 7.8-13.0% (1.6-2.6x). The majority/robustness-check rule is CONSERVATIVE at 1.9-4.6%, under-rejecting rather than inflating. Inflation is governed by the inter-statistic correlation, not grid size alone.

validation.evidence: union 14.1% vs expected 14.4%, argmax 11.3% vs 11.4%, mean corr 0.611 vs 0.605 - all within Monte Carlo error
critical values set at the 95th percentile of each k's own null
